title: BrainRunBundle
description:
The triage input bundle (spec-agent-memory-system.md v1.0 section 4.1): written by `agent-runner` at run exit (or by an interactive close) and handed to `brain triage|harvest <bundle.json>` by path. The toolkit builds its ~3k-token triage prompt from `finalAnswer`, `errorLines` and `diffStat`, and condenses the transcript at `transcriptPath` for harvest.

`transcriptPath` is `null` when no transcript exists (an interactive close); `model`, `effort` and `runtime` are ABSENT when the run did not report them, never guessed.

finalAnswer.description: The run's final answer (may be empty).

errorLines.description: Error lines from the run (may be empty).

diffStat.description: `git diff --stat` of what the run changed (empty string when nothing).

transcriptPath.description: Path of the run transcript, or null when there is none.
